evidence_chain: FormFactor reports two operating segments: Probe Cards and Systems. Its probe-card products include customized MEMS-based probe cards for DRAM including HBM, logic/HPC, networking, NAND flash, co-packaged optical ICs and other device types. Source: FormFactor 2025 Form 10-K via StockTitan, lines 487-498, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-k-formfactor-inc-files-annual-report-b4e6dc675377.html

FormFactor says its probe cards are customized to each customer’s unique wafer/chip layouts and electrical test requirements, and that advanced applications may require tens of thousands or more simultaneous high-fidelity contacts. Source: FormFactor 2025 Form 10-K via StockTitan, lines 493-498, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-k-formfactor-inc-files-annual-report-b4e6dc675377.html

In Q1 2026, FormFactor revenue was $226.144 million versus $171.356 million in Q1 2025, up 32.0% year over year. Probe Cards revenue was $198.257 million and Systems revenue was $27.887 million. Source: FormFactor Q1 2026 Form 10-Q via StockTitan, lines 1259-1289, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-q-formfactor-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-fd4f2595365c.html

Q1 2026 DRAM probe-card revenue was $82.933 million, up 69.7% year over year; Foundry & Logic was $111.188 million, up 30.4%; Flash was $4.136 million, up 73.1% from a small base; Systems fell 19.9%. Source: FormFactor Q1 2026 Form 10-Q via StockTitan, lines 1280-1289, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-q-formfactor-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-fd4f2595365c.html

FormFactor’s Q1 2026 10-Q says the DRAM revenue increase was primarily driven by increased demand for HBM designs used in generative AI, with additional contribution from non-HBM DRAM designs. Source: FormFactor Q1 2026 Form 10-Q via StockTitan, lines 1290-1292, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-q-formfactor-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-fd4f2595365c.html

South Korea revenue increased in Q1 2026, and the filing attributes this to increased demand for DRAM probe-card products including those supporting HBM designs. Source: FormFactor Q1 2026 Form 10-Q via StockTitan, lines 1302-1321, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-q-formfactor-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-fd4f2595365c.html

Probe Cards gross margin in Q1 2026 was 50.5%, up from 37.8% in Q1 2025; the company attributed the increase primarily to favorable product mix, higher utilization and higher volumes, partly offset by tariffs. Source: FormFactor Q1 2026 Form 10-Q via StockTitan, lines 1343-1350, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-q-formfactor-inc-quarterly-earnings-report-fd4f2595365c.html

Customer concentration is material: SK hynix represented 19.2% of revenue in Q4 2025, 24.5% in Q3 2025, 25.0% in Q2 2025 and 23.3% in Q1 2025. Source: FormFactor 2025 Form 10-K via StockTitan, lines 531-546, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-k-formfactor-inc-files-annual-report-b4e6dc675377.html

The 2025 10-K says one customer represented 22.9% of total fiscal 2025 revenue and warns that a small number of customers account for a significant portion of revenue. Source: FormFactor 2025 Form 10-K via StockTitan, lines 692-701, URL: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/FORM/10-k-formfactor-inc-files-annual-report-b4e6dc675377.html

FormFactor’s Q4 2025 press release said FY2025 revenue was a record $785.0 million and was driven by growth in HBM; it also said Q4 had another record DRAM revenue quarter driven by non-HBM DRAM applications like DDR4 and DDR5. This is important because it proves both HBM and non-HBM DRAM can drive reported DRAM strength. Source: FormFactor Q4 2025 press release, lines 17-23, URL: https://investors.formfactor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/formfactor-inc-reports-2025-fourth-quarter-results/

FormFactor’s Q4 2025 press release said management expected Q1 2026 strength in advanced packaging and HPC markets such as HBM in DRAM and network switches in Foundry & Logic. Source: FormFactor Q4 2025 press release, lines 38-45, URL: https://investors.formfactor.com/news-releases/news-release-details/formfactor-inc-reports-2025-fourth-quarter-results/

As of June 10, 2026, the finance tool showed FormFactor market capitalization of about $9.58 billion, placing it in the preferred underfollowed mid-cap range. Source: web finance quote for FORM, June 10, 2026.

The current evidence upgrades the thesis from a pure HBM supply-chain hypothesis to a supported but still unproven chokepoint thesis, because DRAM growth is explicitly tied to HBM in the filing and probe-card margins improved, but FormFactor does not disclose HBM-only revenue or customer-specific HBM exposure.

If HBM4/HBM4E and higher stack counts require more complex probing, more contacts, tighter thermal/electrical tolerances, and more known-good-die screening, FormFactor’s DRAM probe-card ASP, mix and capacity utilization could improve more than commodity DRAM unit growth alone would imply.

A durable shortage of advanced HBM probe-card capability could make FormFactor a second-order beneficiary of AI memory undersupply, but this requires confirmation from lead times, backlog, customer diversification and competitive win data.
falsification_plan: Falsify or downgrade if Q2-Q4 2026 DRAM probe-card growth decelerates toward total company growth while management stops emphasizing HBM or advanced memory as the primary driver.
Falsify or downgrade if non-HBM DRAM, DDR4/DDR5 recovery, Flash or generic memory-cycle demand explains most incremental revenue rather than HBM-related designs.
Falsify or downgrade if customer concentration remains dominated by one HBM customer and no evidence emerges of design wins or revenue contribution from multiple leading memory manufacturers.
Falsify or downgrade if Probe Cards gross margin fails to remain structurally above prior-cycle levels despite claimed favorable HBM mix, after adjusting for restructuring, tariffs and utilization.
Falsify or downgrade if competitors win key HBM4/HBM4E probe-card platforms or if customers qualify alternative suppliers that reduce FormFactor’s share.
Falsify or downgrade if new HBM architectures reduce wafer-level test intensity, rely more on built-in self-test, move more value to downstream package test, or otherwise reduce FormFactor’s role.
Falsify or downgrade if Farmers Branch ramp or site consolidation causes delivery misses, customer dissatisfaction, yield problems or elevated costs that impair the ability to serve HBM demand.

Falsify or downgrade if management guidance shows revenue growth led by Foundry & Logic or Systems without continued DRAM/HBM acceleration, because that would change the thesis from HBM bottleneck to broader semiconductor test recovery.
deep_reports.hidden_signal_to_verify: The key hidden signal is whether HBM-related DRAM probe-card demand is growing faster than non-HBM DRAM, NAND/Flash, foundry/logic and systems revenue, and whether that growth is supported by multiple leading memory customers rather than mostly by SK hynix. In Q1 2026, DRAM probe-card revenue grew 69.7% year over year versus total revenue growth of 32.0%, while systems revenue fell 19.9%; this is a positive but not yet sufficient signal because FormFactor does not disclose HBM-only revenue.

Create a falsification dashboard with quarterly thresholds: DRAM growth premium over total revenue, Probe Cards gross margin, customer concentration, HBM language frequency, capex/start-up costs, and backlog/lead-time commentary.
risks: SK hynix has been a major customer, and Q1 2026 South Korea revenue strength points to Korean DRAM/HBM demand. If one customer pulls forward probe-card orders and later normalizes, the apparent HBM growth could reverse quickly.
FormFactor does not disclose HBM-only revenue. DRAM growth can include non-HBM DDR4, DDR5 or other DRAM designs, and the company’s Q4 2025 release explicitly noted non-HBM DRAM strength.

Probe cards are tied to semiconductor design ramps, wafer starts, unit volumes and test strategies. A memory downturn, HBM capacity digestion phase, or lower-than-expected AI accelerator demand could reduce orders.
The 10-K states that changes in customer test strategies, equipment, design-for-testability, self-test or later-stage testing can reduce probe-card demand.
Other probe-card suppliers may win HBM platforms or pressure pricing. The thesis requires evidence that FormFactor retains technical share in next-generation HBM designs.
Q1 2026 probe-card gross margin improved strongly, but GAAP gross margin was affected by restructuring charges and tariffs. If favorable product mix does not persist, the HBM mix thesis weakens.
The company is consolidating sites and bringing the Farmers Branch, Texas facility online late in fiscal 2026. Start-up costs, yield issues, delays or labor constraints could offset demand strength.
The company relies on limited or sole-source suppliers for key materials and components such as substrates, printed circuit boards, contact elements and interconnects.

At a roughly $9.6 billion market capitalization and high reported P/E as of June 10, 2026, the market may already be pricing in part of the HBM and AI test story. This report is research support, not a buy/sell recommendation.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: AI accelerators and HPC systems -> HBM producers such as SK hynix, Samsung, Micron -> wafer fabrication and HBM die production -> wafer-level electrical test and known-good-die screening -> FormFactor probe cards, MEMS contact elements, probe stations, thermal systems and related test support -> advanced packaging and HBM stacking. FormFactor sits one layer below visible HBM producers and one or two steps away from the obvious AI GPU demand driver.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: HBM 堆叠前筛出 known-good-die 的经济价值随堆叠层数、良率敏感度和封装成本上升而提高。FormFactor 不销售 HBM 本身，而是提供晶圆级测试、定制探针卡和相关测试系统，使客户能在高成本堆叠前识别合格 die。Q1 2026 初步证据显示，该逻辑正在进入财务报表：公司总收入同比增长 32.0%，其中 DRAM 探针卡收入同比增长 69.7%，公司在 10-Q 中称 DRAM 增长主要由用于生成式 AI 的 HBM 设计需求增加驱动。但目前仍需证明这不是普通 DRAM 周期复苏、单一客户拉货或短期产能错配。
deep_reports.thesis_en: [Inference, now partly supported by facts] HBM economics raise the value of known-good-die screening before expensive stacking. As stack height, yield sensitivity, and package cost rise, advanced wafer-level test and customized probe cards can become a hidden manufacturing bottleneck. FormFactor does not sell HBM; it sells test capability that may be required to manufacture HBM economically. Q1 2026 evidence supports the thesis: total revenue rose 32.0% year over year, DRAM probe-card revenue rose 69.7%, and the company’s 10-Q attributed DRAM growth primarily to increased demand for HBM designs used in generative AI. The thesis is not fully proven because investors still need to separate durable HBM test-intensity growth from a normal DRAM cycle, one-customer pull-forward, or temporary capacity tightness.

deep_reports.title_en: FormFactor: A Hidden HBM Bottleneck in Wafer-Level Test and Advanced Probe Cards
deep_reports.why_underfollowed: FormFactor’s AI exposure is hidden behind semiconductor test-equipment labels, probe-card terminology, wafer-level contact mechanics, MEMS probes, and customer-specific design cycles. The market usually sees HBM producers, GPUs, advanced packaging, or memory pricing first. FormFactor is less obvious because its revenue signal is embedded inside DRAM probe-card growth, foundry/logic probe-card growth, geographic shipment mix, customer concentration, and gross-margin mix. It also has non-HBM businesses such as legacy systems, flash, cryogenic systems, probe stations, and foundry/logic products, which blur the purity of the HBM thesis.

summary: Layer 5 mini deep report for FormFactor Inc. (FORM). Core conclusion: the HBM probe-card chokepoint thesis is now supported by primary filing evidence, not just theme inference, because Q1 2026 DRAM probe-card revenue grew much faster than total revenue and management explicitly attributed DRAM growth primarily to HBM designs used in generative AI. However, the thesis remains only partially upgraded because customer concentration, memory cyclicality, lack of explicit HBM-only revenue disclosure, and execution risk around capacity expansion still prevent clean separation of durable HBM test intensity from a broader DRAM recovery.
